body: techmeme.com: Kyt Dotson / SiliconANGLE : Nvidia debuts Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weight model for multilingual audio transcription and translation, and Granary v2, its open-source speech dataset Nvidia Corp. today released a leaderboard-winning open artificial intelligence model for multilingual audio transcription and translation

techcrunch.com: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.
